goal: Minimize reasoning dead time without paid API or always-on user PC while preserving disposable-worker semantics.

layers.mechanism: Current owner checkpoints meaningful work and emits one next-generation event on dedicated PR lane before observed runtime boundary.
layers.gate: Provision a ChatGPT Work GitHub PR commit-update trigger, then pass state/EVENT_WORKER_PROBE.json.

layers.target_latency: 5-minute minimum cadence plus unbounded documented schedule delay; not a <=120s SLO mechanism
layers.mechanism: Public-repo GitHub Actions checks durable liveness and emits at most one PR-lane rescue event only when the event lane is ACTIVE, program nonterminal, owner progress stale >=180s and no generation outstanding.
layers.cron_offset_rationale: GitHub documents schedule events may be delayed or dropped under load, especially near the start of an hour. Offset avoids minute 00 while retaining the five-minute minimum cadence.

layers.target_latency: <=15m after current invocation releases plus scheduler delay
layers.mechanism: Existing canonical scheduled task rotates BYMINUTE across quarter phases.
layers.live_evidence: Epoch 18 remained active across the 01:15 due. Automation last_run_time stayed at prior 00:59:19 and no successor request appeared; current owner recovered schedule to 01:30.

nonnegotiable_invariants: GitHub main is durable source of truth
duplicate wake never implies duplicate substantive side effect
wake event alone never advances authority
no secrets in public event lane
quarter fallback remains enabled until faster layers prove safe

capability_evidence.official_event_task_permission_rule: OpenAI documentation states connected-app permissions and approval requirements continue to apply to event-triggered Work tasks.
capability_evidence.github_schedule_prior_art: Official GitHub docs: minimum schedule interval is 5 minutes; scheduled workflows can be delayed during high load and some queued jobs may be dropped.
capability_evidence.actions_rescue_producer: Guard path self-tested successfully; emission path intentionally inactive until consumer exists.
